title: Light letters: heavy and light side by side: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 12 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Light letters rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 12. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

keywords.def: a light and a heavy letter that sound close, like س and ص

questions.q: Say the pair سَ / صَ, then read «وَصَدَّقَ» (92:6).
questions.a: Light سَ, heavy صَ; in وَصَدَّقَ the ص and ق are heavy, the د light.

questions.q: Listening game (pupil PDF): the teacher says 8 sounds; write L for light or H for heavy. Today's rota group recites 92:8 to 14 to the teacher in turn.
questions.a: Answers depend on the sounds read; the teacher reads: صَ تَ قَ سَ ظَ دَ خَ كَ = H L H L H L H L.

questions.q: Extend: write the six light and heavy pairs.
questions.a: س ص, ت ط, د ض, ذ ظ, ك ق, ح خ

questions.q: Stretch: find a word in Al-Layl with a light and a heavy letter side by side.
In «وَصَدَّقَ», which letter must stay light?
questions.a: A) د. د is light even between two heavy letters. ص and ق are heavy.

questions.q: Which pair is light then heavy?
Think again: 'Seen' or 'saad'? 'Taa' or 'taa'? If you mix them up, could a word change its meaning?
questions.a: Yes: Arabic letters are different sounds. سَيْف (sword) and صَيْف (summer) differ only by light or heavy.
